scope: Read-only verification of existing experiment records and documented design; Q&A refinement without new simulation or change to numerical results.

planar_success.rule: final recorded position_error <= 0.1 m AND yaw_error <= 0.1 rad AND minimum logged barrier >= -0.01 m
planar_success.population: 300 accepted collision-free IK scenes; 340 sampling rejections before acceptance are not a standalone end-to-end failure rate

panda_success.rule: at least one recorded goal hit AND minimum logged barrier >= -0.001 m AND minimum joint margin >= 0 AND no numerical solver failure
panda_success.population: 1000 IK-accepted scenes per Validation/Test split; same scenes across methods

candidate_scope.execution_order: ascending link index; fixed before rollout
candidate_scope.documented_status: fixed design choice and evaluated scope; neither optimal sequence length nor necessity of endpoint exclusions or ascending ordering established

recommended_short_slide_copy.success_definition: Goal reached safely within the time limit

safety_statement: Recorded approximate-model acceptance is distinct from continuous physical collision-avoidance certification; numerical tolerances do not bound geometry approximation error.

feedback_interpretation.shared_workspace_term: ISO collaboration context; replaced with Cluttered Workspaces for the depicted equipment scene
feedback_interpretation.human_inspiration: Design intuition, not a universal biomechanics claim
feedback_interpretation.goncalves_dimension: Even-dimensional basic theory plus separate odd-dimensional extension
